introHtml: Travis Mathew briefcases combine the brand's signature golf-inspired style with practical functionality for the modern professional. Made from durable materials with clean lines and subtle branding, these briefcases are ideal for corporate gifts, sales teams, or executive onboarding. Options like the Duration Duffle or Duration Roller offer versatile carry solutions that transition seamlessly from office to travel. Add your company logo via embroidery or screen printing for a polished look that resonates with your team or clients.
